description: This file defines the 'QuestionnaireScoringForm' class, which extends an abstract form processor and implements form handling features for a questionnaire scoring interface within the Goteo project. It includes methods to create the form and save data, managing scoring answers, associated documents, and form validation.

classes.name: QuestionnaireScoringForm
classes.description: A form processor class for handling questionnaire scoring, including creating scoring forms with scores and associated files, as well as persisting the scores after validation.

methods.name: createForm
methods.description: Initializes the form with scoring answers, scores, questions, and associated file uploads, configuring form fields dynamically based on the provided options.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Validates the form data and updates the Score objects with new scores, ensuring they are within valid bounds.
